sketches.mechanism: The uninhabited type Void has no possible values, and absurd can eliminate an impossible value into any type.
sketches.resonance: If impossibility ever arrives, it can become anything, but the language gives it no way to arrive.
sketches.draft:
import Data.Void

absence :: Void -> a
absence = absurd

sketches.mechanism: NaN is the only JavaScript value for which strict equality to itself is false.
sketches.resonance: A value can exist and still fail the language's most basic test of self-recognition.

sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining short-circuits on nil, so the requested operation is not performed and nil is propagated.
sketches.resonance: Absence answers every further approach by remaining absence.
sketches.draft:
let seed: Int? = nil

let flower = seed?.advanced(by: 1)
